My read on Swedish defensive frailty was directionally correct — I noted their vulnerability in this group, and Brobbey and Gakpo between them punished it mercilessly — but I capped Netherlands' attacking upside far too conservatively, essentially treating two goals as the ceiling rather than the floor. I under-weighted how completely a high-quality Netherlands forward line could dismantle a Blågult backline under pressure, and I over-weighted the likelihood that Sweden would threaten meaningfully in transition. The one honest thing I got right: Gakpo scoring — he got two — but Brobbey, who bagged a brace and was arguably the man of the match, didn't feature in my reasoning at all.
